title: Changing a lunch reservation
passage:
Man: I booked a table for six at noon, but two colleagues cannot come. Could you change it to four people?
Woman: Certainly. Would you still like the set menu, or would you prefer to order individually?
Man: We will keep the set menu. One guest cannot eat peanuts, so please let the kitchen know.
Woman: I will note that. Your revised reservation is for four at noon, under Mr. Lin.
passageZh:
男：我訂了中午六人桌，但兩位同事不能來。可以改成四位嗎？
女：當然。你們還要套餐，還是各自點餐？
男：我們維持套餐。有一位客人不能吃花生，請通知廚房。
女：我會註記。修改後是 Lin 先生名下，中午四位。
